verdict.rationale: Glama documents a browser-based MCP Inspector for testing servers, including local ones exposed through a tunnel. It also documents private-by-default hosting and per-tool access control. None of these is a sandbox environment isolated from production data: the inspector calls whatever server you point it at, and access controls only restrict live calls. So the evidence is adjacent at best, and no isolated test or sandbox mode is documented.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
